name: Vaishali
desc: FC Road institution since 1951, famous for SPDP, sambar idli and filter coffee.

name: Roopali
desc: Student favourite on FC Road for quick, cheap South Indian breakfasts.

name: Wadeshwar
desc: Known for butter dosa, upma and filter coffee.

name: Cafe Good Luck
desc: Irani café since 1935: bun maska, chai and keema pav.

name: Joshi Wadapav
desc: Quick, cheap vada pav right on FC Road.

name: Kalyan Bhel
desc: Pune's favourite for bhel, SPDP and pani puri.

name: Bedekar Misal
desc: Legendary Narayan Peth misal pav with a sweet-spicy tarri.

name: Durvankur Dining Hall
desc: Unlimited Maharashtrian thali off Tilak Road.

name: Darja Misal
desc: No-frills misal joint loved by locals.

name: Marz-O-Rin
desc: MG Road classic for sandwiches and cold coffee since 1965.

name: Vohuman Cafe
desc: Irani café near Pune station, famous for its cheese omelette and chai.

name: German Bakery
desc: Iconic Koregaon Park bakery-café.

name: Malaka Spice
desc: Pan-Asian restaurant with art-filled garden seating.

name: The Great Punjab
desc: Hearty North Indian food in Koregaon Park.

name: Toit
desc: One of Pune's best-known brewpubs.

name: Kalyani Veg
desc: Reliable pure-veg family restaurant.

name: Sujata Mastani
desc: Pune's signature mastani: a thick milkshake topped with ice cream and dry fruit.

name: Katraj Junction
desc: Family restaurant near Katraj chowk.

name: Yewale Amruttulya
desc: Pune's go-to cutting chai chain.

name: Katakirrr
desc: Fiery Kolhapuri-style misal that lives up to its name.

name: Joshi Upahar Gruha
desc: Homely Maharashtrian snacks: sabudana khichdi, poha, thalipeeth.

name: Nisarg
desc: Malvani and Konkani seafood thalis.

name: NaadBrahma Idli
desc: Budget idli chain, quick and filling.

name: Cafe Peter
desc: Popular café with ramen, pasta and coffee.

name: Chitale Bandhu
desc: Outlet of Pune's most famous sweet shop, known for its bakarwadi.

name: JW Marriott Pune
desc: 5-star hotel on Senapati Bapat Road.

name: Hotel Shreyas
desc: Long-running mid-range hotel, walkable to FC Road.

name: Smart Inn
desc: Budget stay in the heart of Deccan.

name: Conrad Pune
desc: Luxury hotel near Koregaon Park.

name: Vivanta Blue Diamond
desc: Classic Taj-group hotel in Koregaon Park.

name: Vib O Stay
desc: Backpacker-friendly hostel beds.

name: Sheraton Grand Pune
desc: Upscale hotel on Bund Garden Road.

name: Lemon Tree Premier
desc: Mid-range business hotel near Pune station.

name: Hyatt Regency Pune
desc: Close to the airport on Nagar Road.

name: Novotel Pune
desc: Upscale hotel near the airport.

name: Ginger Hotel Wakad
desc: Value business hotel for the IT corridor.

name: Viva Inn
desc: Budget hotel on the Kothrud side.

name: Sarasbaug
desc: Garden with the Talyatla Ganpati temple, plus street food outside in the evenings.

name: Joshi's Museum of Miniature Railways
desc: A whole miniature city with working trains.

name: Empress Botanical Garden
desc: A green 39-acre garden, great for a morning walk.

name: Bund Garden
desc: Riverside garden with boating.

name: Osho Teerth Park
desc: Quiet bamboo-and-stream park in Koregaon Park.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park
desc: Katraj zoo with a snake park and a white tiger.

name: R K Laxman Museum
desc: Celebrates the cartoonist and his Common Man.

name: Phoenix Marketcity
desc: Big mall with food court, cinema and shopping.

name: Amanora Mall
desc: Large mall in Amanora Park Town.

name: Shaniwar Wada
desc: Seat of the Peshwas, built in 1732. The fortified gates survive, and there's an evening light-and-sound show.

name: Lal Mahal
desc: Reconstructed palace where young Shivaji Maharaj lived, and site of the 1663 raid on Shaista Khan.

name: Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati
desc: Pune's most famous Ganpati temple, founded in 1893 and the heart of Ganeshotsav.

name: Kasba Ganpati
desc: Pune's presiding deity (gramdaivat), first of the five Manache Ganpati.

name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
desc: One man's collection of thousands of everyday artefacts: lamps, instruments, doors and more.

name: Parvati Hill
desc: Climb about 100 steps to Peshwa-era temples with a panoramic city view.

name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
desc: 8th-century rock-cut Shiva temple carved from a single basalt rock.

name: Aga Khan Palace
desc: Built in 1892. Gandhi and Kasturba were interned here in 1942–44, and Kasturba's samadhi is here.

name: Shinde Chhatri
desc: Memorial to Mahadji Shinde, with ornate Rajasthani-style architecture.

name: National War Memorial (Southern Command)
desc: War memorial built largely through citizens' contributions.

name: Sinhagad Fort
desc: Hill fort of Tanaji Malusare's 1670 battle. Go for the trek, then pithla-bhakri at the top.
